title: IMEX：基于交互的模型解释方法
summary: IMEX是一种可解释预测建模方法，通过静态相关功率(PCS)和交互相关功率(PCI)两个互补指标，识别对预测贡献最大的变量及变量间交互作用，支持高阶交互分析，构建预测的可解释性图谱。实验验证了PCS在非线性、条件性和多重共线性关系下恢复特征结构的能力。
summary_en: IMEX is an explainable predictive modeling approach that uses two complementary metrics, Static Correlation Power (PCS) and Interaction Correlation Power (PCI), to identify important variables and interactions, supporting higher-order analysis. Experiments validate PCS's ability to recover feature structures under non-linear, conditional, and multicollinear relationships.
